taglio: A rain-dark swordsmith courtyard, ribbons of cut silk on horizontal drying poles, clean slices through hanging reeds, one slender chipped blade planted near the edge. Pale silver and charcoal, razor-sharp silhouettes, no fortress.
perforante: A dry thorn canyon with slender natural stone needles piercing hanging leaves; a field traveller has left an awl, pierced leather flask and torn map beside the path. Ochre and muted mauve.
contundente: A low dwarven crushing mill in a cavern, a huge stone hammer resting after work, shattered ceramic bowls and compressed ore. Warm stone dust, solid blunt shapes.
fuoco: An intimate abandoned glassmaker workshop still alive with red coals and curling flame, cooling glass birds and a fireproof glove on a sill. Crimson, black charcoal and orange fire; no sun.
vento: A windswept plateau with bent wild grasses and long empty fabric streamers stretched between weathered wooden posts; feathers drift above a suspended footbridge. Pale turquoise, blue and silver, wide fresh air.
acqua: A secluded turquoise freshwater spring inside a fern-filled grotto, layered waterfalls running into clear pools, shells along a worn stepping-stone path, a tiny wooden cup and damp travel cloak left by a visitor. Underwater refracted light, mint, blue and aquamarine, organic rounded rock forms. No castle, no sun, no coins, no circular eye emblems.
terra: A vast cutaway earthen valley with terracotta sediment layers, burrowing roots, clay dwellings and a worker's battered shovel. Dense fertile brown, sienna and moss, ancient physical strata.
sonoro: An abandoned outdoor music garden: suspended bronze tuning forks, hollow reeds, strings stretched across weathered beams, rain droplets visibly trembling in shallow dishes. Violet and muted brass, sound conveyed by vibration.
psichico: An impossible quiet library whose floor and walls fold into a single continuous ribbon; translucent fragments of remembered rooms hover between bookshelves. Mauve, blue-grey, soft magenta, one empty chair, no eyeballs.
lava: A close basalt caldera interior where thick glowing lava flows beneath a cracked natural arch, a small miner's refuge built on a cool shelf. Black porous rock and intense red-orange fissures.
fulmine: A high storm plain with thin copper lightning rods set on wind-worn rocks, branching violet-white lightning joining the rods, an old rain-soaked repair shelter below. Electric blue, violet and cold rain. No solar disc or currency.
veleno: A still green marsh with low poisonous plants and translucent venom sacs, an overturned hunter's vial and a moth caught in iridescent oil. Deep olive, sickly yellow, purple shadows.
cenere: An abandoned kiln village after the fire, soft ash buried at the feet of doorway beams, three small seedlings breaking through a grey mound, a rescued clay doll on a doorstep. Quiet greys and restrained ember red.
sangue: A dark red ritual infirmary with clean bandages, a chipped crimson basin and red threads stitched through torn cloth; a single drop falls into water. Restrained burgundy and bone, no gore spectacle.
cristallo: A deep crystal nursery cavern with translucent angular mineral fans and tiny flowers rooted in their fractures, an old surveyor's prism on a wooden stool. Amethyst, cyan and pale rose refraction.
oscuro: A narrow market alley after all lamps have been covered, darkness flowing like soft velvet under doors; one lantern wick has just gone out beside abandoned footprints. Indigo-black with dim reflected violet.
lunare: An earthly sanctuary of the lost GOOD Moon: silver crescent carvings on a low memorial, blue flowers, a carefully mended lunar banner watched over by tiny allied star lights. The actual sky is EMPTY of the Moon. Melancholic indigo and silver, protective rather than sinister.
solare: An oppressive solar outpost in a dry white valley, rich gold standards above chained irrigation pipes; one enormous sun in the sky with a GOLD/ORANGE IRIS and DARK PUPIL exactly like Benedict's sun. Small exhausted travellers below. Gold, pale ochre, burnt orange and cold blue shadows.
vapium: A fantastical steam greenhouse with brass pressure pipes exhaling pearly vapour around curling plants, frosted glass valves and a patched attendant's coat. Oxidised copper, lavender mist and muted green.
osso: A windswept ancient animal bone field, huge rib arches used as shelters, delicate small bones woven into protective chimes, a traveller's white feather caught between them. Ivory and dry blue-grey, no skull repetition.
gravita: An impossible ravine where loose slate rocks hover in concentric tilted layers and a waterfall bends sideways toward a dense dark stone suspended in air. Cool plum and grey, gravity through physical motion.
vuoto: A silent flat plain ending at an irregular absence in reality, torn edges reveal neither sky nor stars, just matte depth; a single untethered boat rests on dry sand. Almost-black, muted violet and pale dust.
sogno: A sleeping child's impossible bedroom opening into softly layered floating stairs, oversized paper boats among luminous blue-indigo-violet-pastel-pink clouds. Gentle surreal forms, no castle.
metallo: An old metalworker's foundry with sheets of hammered silver, folded copper, forged iron tools and a small repaired bird automaton, cold shafts of light across scratches. Physical metal weight, no coins.
postea: A moving runic workshop mounted on tall wheeled legs, streets of reused machines, workers carrying rune-etched spare arms; absolutely no modern electronic displays. Patinated teal and copper.
radice: A forest hollow beneath the exposed intertwined roots of a colossal fallen tree, tiny clay cups and a rope ladder woven between root arches. Amber wood and emerald shade.
slime: A luminous subterranean pool of translucent slimes of different sizes, rounded jelly ripples and floating leaves trapped softly inside them; tiny discarded boots at the edge. Mint, blue and pale pink.
oculum: An intimate violet magical study with streams of purple Oculum weaving between translucent crystal rods, one living almond-shaped magical aperture hovering above an open stone cradle. NOT a coin or round currency disc.
stella: A high observatory under an elaborate protective star sky, repaired silver astrolabe and lunar-allied banners, a handwritten chart with no legible text. Deep indigo and many small cool star lights, no Moon body.
corrotto: A once beautiful orchard overtaken by black branching veins in the fruit and rust-coloured mould, a clean uninfected sapling guarded inside a cracked glass bell. Green, bruised violet and orange rot.
nonmorto: An underground resting hall where gentle blue soul lanterns illuminate empty armour and wrapped resting places, a skeletal caretaker carefully watering white flowers. Bone, faded green, dusky blue.
acido: A corroded alchemist drainage yard where chartreuse acid eats holes through a copper gutter, frosted glass vessels and dissolving metal fragments; purple flowers growing far from the runoff. Chartreuse and plum.
sacro: A remote austere high-grade sacred plateau where immense stone doors bear solar judgement seals, severe white architecture, heavy gold chains and abandoned pilgrim shoes. A small sky-visible sun must match Benedict's eye; authority feels oppressive, no friendly lunar solar conflation.
diabolico: A LUNAR-ALLIED black castle in the Diabolical realm, red CRESCENT EMBLEM carved on its gate, warm protected homes at the base, glaciers on one side and volcanic land on the other. Devils are mostly lunar allies, depict a watchful protective guard, not evil worship. NO Moon body in the sky.
angelico: A precise angelic weapons hall with white-feather motifs, pale gilded bows and hanging armour, an immense wing-shaped roof. Porcelain white, cold blue and light gold. No gigantic eye or coin.
necrotico: A dark bog where decayed tree trunks feed clusters of pale bioluminescent fungi, an old healer's satchel half reclaimed by roots. Peat black, pale green and muted violet, slow decomposition.
magia: A whimsical apprentice's stone attic with jars of coloured weather, floating folded paper creatures and a wand mended with thread. Saturated cobalt, magenta and gold accents, no sun or coins.
energia: An abstract landscape of flowing luminous ribbons passing through solid dark rock cavities, pools of radiance collecting in shallow bowls. Cyan, violet and soft white energy, distinct smooth wave geometry.
esplosivo: A quarry after a controlled blast, rock chunks suspended in a forceful outward arc, dust and torn safety ribbons, an abandoned cracked blasting cage. Rust orange, dust grey, bright spark accents.
radiazione: A silent exclusion garden under translucent protective glass, luminous pale-green crystals, a cracked measuring instrument with no text and plants bending away from a hot core. Pale yellow-green, teal and grey.
plasma: An industrial rune chamber with a twisting pink-white plasma column trapped between ceramic rings, a scorched grounding blade and cooled blue glass drips. Fuchsia, ultraviolet and cyan.
tecnologia: A runic maintenance bay at Postea, intricate mechanical limbs hung from racks, a repair robot sorting tiny gears by hand, etched rune plates instead of screens. Steel blue, oxidised orange, precise but lived-in.
proiettile: A quiet marksman's wooden practice range with gouged targets, brass cartridge casings and a cloth-wrapped barrel, a long splintered plank showing a projectile's clean path. Walnut, steel and faded red.
laser: A dark precision workshop where a narrow red laser cuts a clean geometric path across hanging glass prisms, thin beams scatter in pale blue haze. Black, crimson and icy white, sharp linear composition.
tempo: An overgrown station with a giant stopped pendulum, flowers in four different stages of bloom and a pocket watch resting beside an aged fresh loaf. Bronze, dusty rose and faded teal, no clock face text.
spazio: A tranquil impossible room of floating doorways opening onto different distant terrains, suspended stair segments and a small folded travel bag. Indigo, silver and pastel pink, no same castle composition.
caos: A vivid disordered garden where geometric stone, fluid paint, unseasonal flowers and gravity-defying rain collide, one intact teacup resting amid the discord. Cobalt, violet and unusual acid green accents.
natura: An old forest clearing after rainfall with a mossy fallen log, wild flowers, small animal tracks and a woven nest sheltered beneath broad leaves. True rich greens, warm bark and filtered blue shadows.
pianta: A dense walled botanical garden with giant leaves, climbing vines forming natural arches, seed pods opening over an old terracotta planting bench. Verdant greens, ochre and tiny violet flowers.
bestiale: A low view into a forest den with rubbed bark, a well-trodden animal trail, a shed claw and a huge shaggy silhouette resting behind ferns. Amber, deep earth and muted forest green.
maledizione: A shuttered house with red knotted threads stretched across the threshold, a cracked porcelain doll and black wax pooled around a covered mirror. Burgundy, slate and cold violet.
benedizione: A peaceful travellers' shelter where repaired blankets and a bowl of clean water are bathed in gentle warm light, a protective small carved hand hangs above the doorway. Soft ivory, pale blue and warm rose, no solar emblem.
cura: An intimate herbalist's kitchen with fresh green herbs, bowls of clear restorative broth, clean linen and a mended walking staff. Warm wood, sage green and delicate peach, restorative care shown in objects.
vero: A stark clear mountain spring reflecting every stone with perfect accuracy, a transparent unbroken prism beside a rough unpainted stone. Cool white, clear blue and honest natural surfaces.
sconosciuto: A fog-covered stair leading to an unmarked doorway grown into an unfamiliar organic rock, strange but believable tiny footprints ending at the threshold. Muted blue-grey, pale amber and hidden violet, no eye symbol.
